text: ONE MONTH LATER.
With practiced paws, I gathered up the balls and redeemed them at the counter.
What fun pachinko was! Now, every day shone with the vibrance of spinning steel and flickering scoreboards.
I passed through a chilly alleyway, dotted by neon signs. My ears twitched at the cold.
A shiver hollowed my bones as a gust of wind tore by and toppled a signpost.
Behind the exchange booth, a tall, imposing shark stood staring directly at me. He seemed nothing like the other attendants.
I would have thought him impolite, but somehow I felt he’d noticed something inside of me.

name: Maneki
text: Excuse me.
Avoiding his intense gaze, I set the voucher on the counter.
He twisted the slip in his broad hands, as if to test its authenticity. A pleased look crossed his snout.

name: Attendant
text: Why, you’re one lucky cat and you don’t even know it. I expect you’ve encountered the game Waterfall.

name: Maneki
text: What about it?

name: Attendant
text: You could say she’s a [b]special[/b] sort of game. Are you familiar with the old woman who used to come by– the one in the ruby jacket?
A few days ago, she’d stopped visiting the parlor. Probably struck so many jackpots that she could escape this concrete jungle.

name: Maneki
text: Some people are simply blessed with good luck. I’m… not one of them.
The man chuckled, his tone unexpectedly rich and shimmery like gold.

name: Attendant
text: Luck, you say. But unlike you, she only ever played a single game.

name: Maneki
text: You can’t possibly mean Waterfall is responsible for her success?

name: Attendant
text: If you don’t believe me, how about you play Waterfall tomorrow? You’ve plenty to spare– all you need to do is keep playing.
Stooping down, he caught the voucher between his sharp fangs and disappeared inside the booth.
A moment later, he returned bearing a bundle of yen.

name: Maneki
text: Um, by the way!
Strange as he might be, talking to this guy had loosened my tongue.

name: Maneki
text: I’m Maneki. What’s your name?
The man paused, his eyes narrowing. When he spoke, he did so with a calculated smile.

name: Samejima
text: Call me Samejima.
He whisked his tail and slid the cash into my paws.

name: Maneki
text: Thank you.

name: Samejima
text: I’ll see you around, lucky cat.
As I departed to catch the train, a giddy feeling bubbled steadily up my chest. Maybe if I played Waterfall like he said, I really could win something.
I could just make a little money, then go home. That would be easy!
